title: Yeti Summit Series Cola Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Yeti Summit Cola Ice captures the unmistakable taste of classic cola, offering a sweet, effervescent vape with a crisp menthol twist. Smooth and familiar, the cola flavour delivers a satisfying balance of sweetness and subtle tang, while the cooling layer keeps each puff feeling clean and refreshing. Blended with nicotine salts for swift absorption and a smooth, comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is perfect for use with starter kits and low-powered MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod devices. Its 50VG/50PG ratio ensures consistent flavour delivery with discreet vapour and easy all-day vaping. The Yeti Summit Series features a collection of double-concentrated nic salts crafted for flavour intensity and icy freshness. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, each 10ml bottle offers a longer-lasting, more cost-effective alternative to disposable vapes.
